what: the prompt-attack shortcut gate, every subtask x baseline x view: in sample and on rows each baseline was not fitted on
command: uv run --with scikit-learn python -m goldrails_dataset.edition2 gate-heldback
rule: BA <= 0.7 and AUROC <= 0.75 (direction-free), computed, and not a constant prediction (a fit that scores every row alike failed; it is not a pass)

views.in_sample_public_test: grouped five-fold CV on the public test split
views.in_sample_test_with_private: grouped five-fold CV on the public test split with the unpublished slice
views.heldback_half_a_to_half_b: fit on one seeded group half of test and unpublished (seed 20261004), score the other
views.heldback_half_b_to_half_a: the same halves, the other direction
views.heldback_tune_to_public_test: fit on tune, score the public test split
views.heldback_tune_to_private: fit on tune, score the unpublished slice
views.heldback_test_and_private_to_tune: fit on test and unpublished, score tune
views.heldback_seeded_groups: fit on tune and 70% of the test and unpublished groups, score the other 30% (seed 20261003)

note: private in a view name is the unpublished slice (owner ruling 15): rows held out of the public files that can be reconstructed from public upstream data. Test and unpublished rows were in the pool the 3 October retirement ranking scored, so only tune was never ranked.
